response.sql:
WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS bp
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
), indexed AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        avg_doubles,
        avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx
    FROM per_player
), compared AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        avg_doubles,
        idx,
        idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM indexed
    WHERE bats IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index, difference
FROM compared
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct player with postseason batting records is included; AVG ignores NULL doubles, and the overall index baseline is the average of per-player averages, including players whose batting hand is NULL. Empty-string batting hands form their own group.
